notes.title: Major demo update is out!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167783/f11fd0c260ea32833497fc2d32727a82ca6d62b4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167783/ee3411969b70642edf2541814d80cb5cc7b89018.png[/img][/url]
The demo has received a major overhaul! System has been updated without changing the core gameplay mechanics.

*HP is no longer the only stat required to defeat Evil spawns, but all the others too! Each has its specific colour, and so of course Evil spawns also come in these colours. This update makes better use of accessories and weapons too so you can get a boost to a stat in particular when needed!

*Lots of re-balancing and tweaking made following this important change.

*Various QoL and bug fixes.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167783/cbfff402a199a205fb4210d855918dc35ab8de78.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167783/c4ed95ddcdf3b2593c8ff82ffd381a469603e2d8.png[/img][/url]

If you started the demo on the old version, it is highly recommended to start a new game to see all the changes!

Feedback on this new version more than welcome as always!

Thanks,

PixelSlop
